title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy img-src allows a wildcard source
description: The Content-Security-Policy img-src directive contains a bare wildcard, so image subresources may come from any origin. Image requests are the cheapest exfiltration channel available to injected markup: a crafted URL carries the data in the path and the browser sends it without a script execution or a CORS preflight.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit img-src directive.
risk: Page data can leave through image requests to attacker-chosen hosts; MEDIUM severity because the channel needs an injection point to start from.
